From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & audit-period clarification

Hi Alice,

Hope you're doing well — quick ask from our compliance team as we prepare FinEdge's onboarding checklist. Could you please share your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the audit period and an accompanying bridge letter if the report's period does not include the last 30–90 days? For our records we need: 

- The SOC 2 Type II report PDF (redacted as needed)
- The audit period covered (start/end dates)
- A signed bridge letter describing coverage to date and any known gaps (if applicable)
- A short manifest of what, if anything, was redacted (one-line items)
- Optionally: a sample of retention log or proof of access (1–2 redacted rows) to validate log shape

Secure transfer options we accept: pre-signed S3 link, ShareFile/SharePoint with organization-level encryption, or a secure Drive folder (see our secure-share page). If helpful, I attached a short template for a bridge letter and a transfer-options note.

Deadline: if possible, please upload by EOD Friday (2025-05-30). If that won't work, tell me a date that is realistic and we'll coordinate.

If you'd like a one-line reply template for your legal/compliance team, feel free to use the snippet below.

One-line reply (copy/paste):
"We will provide our SOC 2 Type II report covering [YYYY-MM-DD — YYYY-MM-DD] along with a bridge letter; delivery via pre-signed S3 by [date]."

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if there are any blockers.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Trust & Security Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2-Bridge-Sample.docx, transfer-options.md

Hi Alice — appreciate the quick reply. Answers inline below and a short bridge-letter checklist to help your security team: 

1) Audit period: that's fine — please state the covered period clearly in the bridge letter ("This report covers 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31"). We'll note the gap for our internal record and mark the report as covering that period.

2) Signature: a scanned PDF signature is acceptable. Please include signatory name, title, company, and the date signed.

3) Logs: please send a single redacted sample (1–3 rows) that preserves column names and timestamp formats. We do NOT need full extracts. If you must send extracts, please anonymize personal data first.

Transfer options: pre-signed S3 is best for us. SFTP is acceptable if your team prefers, but we'll need an SFTP account and an SFTP user name/email to provision access (security will request IP allowlist details).

Manifest wording (recommended short format):
"Redaction manifest: Redacted columns: [user_email, user_id]; Redaction method: irreversible hashing; Reason: personal data minimization; Rows omitted: full log extracts withheld; Provided: 1 sample row (redacted)."

Bridge-letter checklist (copy for your legal/compliance):
- Statement of audit period covered (dates)
- Confirmation whether any control exceptions are known and whether they are remediated
- Signatory name/title and date
- Indicate if the letter is intended to "bridge" coverage to a more recent date and state the effective coverage date of the bridge (e.g., "covers through 2025-03-31") if applicable
- If not covering recent period, state planned timing for the next engagement (optional)

Example short bridge sentence (if you are bridging):
"This bridge letter confirms that, to the best of the company's knowledge, there have been no material changes to the system controls described in the SOC 2 report between 2025-01-01 and 2025-05-31."

Attachments I referenced (attached here): SOC2-Bridge-Sample.docx, transfer-options.md — use these as a template. If you want, Rishi or David can join a quick 15m call to walk through the transfer setup.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Trust & Security Manager
Redwood Inference
